methods.anomaly: value minus the mean of the same calendar month over all usable years of the same series; no gap filling
methods.ols: least-squares slope of monthly anomalies on time; standard error, t-test p and confidence interval use the effective sample size n(1-r1)/(1+r1) from the lag-1 autocorrelation of residuals (Santer et al. 2000); *_uncorrected fields assume independence
methods.mk_hamed_rao: Mann-Kendall with Hamed-Rao (1998) variance correction for autocorrelation, on anomalies; p is null when the corrected variance is not positive
methods.mk_seasonal: Seasonal Mann-Kendall (period 12) on the monthly values
methods.sen: Theil-Sen slope of anomalies with its confidence interval (assumes independence)
methods.fdr: Benjamini-Hochberg across all analyzed series of this run, separately for each test; p_fdr is the adjusted p value
